title: Context fact
description: One fact about the business, carrying its provenance. The context pack is a set of these. Invariant 2: only an established fact may reach published copy, schema, or a claim made to a customer.

key.description: Dotted and stable, e.g. offer.primary, audience.vocabulary, proof.credentials, voice.example

provenance.description: established: observed in a citable source. inferred: reasoned, may guide strategy, may never be asserted. unknown: looked for, not found. conflict: sources disagree, needs a human.

ref.description: URL, file path, or connected data source.

source.description: Required in practice for established facts. A fact with no source cannot be established.

stale_after.description: Facts decay. Prices, staff, opening hours and claims need re-checking.

conflict_detail.description: When provenance is conflict: what disagrees, so a human can settle it.

publishable.description: Derived, never hand-set: true only when provenance is established and the fact is not stale.
